##### Project general facts

Amer Al Ghurair Residences is a thoughtfully designed residential community offering a selection of studios, 1, 2, and spacious 3.5-bedroom apartments that combine modern living with a strong connection to nature. The project creates a balanced lifestyle environment where architecture, greenery, and open spaces come together to provide both comfort and tranquility. With expansive floor-to-ceiling windows, each residence is filled with natural light and offers calming views of the surrounding landscape.

The community is enriched with a wide range of amenities that promote wellness, activity, and family living. Residents can enjoy landscaped jogging and cycling tracks, swimming pools, and dedicated wellness zones, as well as sports facilities including football, basketball, and padel courts. Carefully designed children’s play areas and social spaces encourage interaction and create a vibrant yet relaxed neighborhood atmosphere suitable for all lifestyles.

The apartments feature modern finishing with high-quality materials and are equipped with smart home systems for added convenience. Kitchens come fully fitted with Bosch appliances, ensuring both functionality and contemporary design, while the units are offered unfurnished, allowing residents to personalize their living spaces according to their own style and preferences.

##### Location description and benefits

Legends in Dubai is a prestigious residential community that blends luxury, comfort, and an active lifestyle in a serene and well-connected setting. Surrounded by lush greenery and positioned alongside a world-class golf course, the area offers breathtaking views and a peaceful environment, making it a true sanctuary for residents seeking both elegance and tranquility. Its master-planned design ensures seamless access to the city while maintaining the privacy and exclusivity of a gated neighborhood.

One of Legends’ standout advantages is its prime location, placing residents within minutes of premium retail outlets, gourmet dining, international schools, and healthcare facilities. The community is also ideal for outdoor enthusiasts, with its landscaped walking trails, cycling paths, and easy access to parks and sports amenities. Whether for families, professionals, or retirees, Legends offers a lifestyle that combines convenience with world-class leisure options.

Another key benefit of Legends is its architectural diversity. The residences, ranging from elegant townhouses to luxurious villas, are designed with contemporary finishes, spacious layouts, and large windows that bring in natural light and frame stunning golf course or garden views. This combination of prime location, exceptional amenities, and high-quality living spaces makes Legends one of the most sought-after addresses in Dubai.
